title: Nitrone chemistry: a versatile gateway to diverse heterocycles
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,292-331
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07748F, Review Article

Suhasini Mohapatra, Kamalika Prusty, Subhashree Bhol, Gopinatha Panigrahi, Sabita Nayak
A concise overview of recent advances (2021–2025) in nitrone chemistry, emphasizing metal-catalyzed and metal-free cycloadditions, emerging photoredox and asymmetric strategies, and their impact on constructing diverse heterocycles.
